summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. filed a 6-K reporting that its board unanimously accepted the resignation of Cristina San Jose Brosa as a director and member of the Risk and Compliance Committee, effective September 25, 2026. The board expressed thanks for her service. This is a non-US filing equivalent to a US Form 8-K disclosing a board departure. No replacement, succession timetable, or strategic rationale was stated. The abrupt exit from a risk oversight role warrants watching for governance or compliance concerns, though no transaction or deal terms are involved.
